name: OmaPilot
author: Spencer Bull
description: Use authenticated AI harnesses from a native Omarchy desktop surface.

barWidget.description: Work through an authenticated AI harness without leaving the Omarchy bar.

schema.label: Harness
schema.description: Choose one harness explicitly. Built-in uses OmaPilot's native Pi runtime; the others use their logged-in ACP harness without fallback.

schema.label: Last built-in model
schema.description: Empty uses the built-in default; discovered Codex, OpenAI, Grok, and OpenAI-compatible models are selected in OmaPilot.

schema.label: Last Codex model
schema.description: Empty uses the Codex default; discovered models are selected in OmaPilot.

schema.label: Last OpenCode model
schema.description: Empty uses the OpenCode default; discovered models are selected in OmaPilot.

schema.label: Desktop context
schema.description: Attach a bounded active-window, open-app, workspace, and playing-media snapshot to each new request.

schema.label: Search provider
schema.description: Choose where OmaPilot opens current-information questions. AI sites also receive a paste-ready copy; answers stay in the browser.

schema.label: Surface
schema.description: Answer from the compact bar panel, from a full-height console docked to the right edge of the focused output, or from that same console filling the screen.

schema.label: Hold the column open
schema.description: Let the docked console tile with your windows instead of floating over them. Opening and closing it reflows the layout.

schema.label: Dangerous auto-approve
schema.description: Automatically select each exact tool request's Allow once option instead of prompting.

schema.label: Enable voice
schema.description: Allow talking to OmaPilot and speaking answers after a TTS provider is ready.

schema.label: TTS provider
schema.description: ElevenLabs is the guided default. Kokoro is local; ElevenLabs and OpenAI keys are stored in voice-auth.json.

schema.label: TTS model
schema.description: Empty uses the selected provider's default model.

schema.label: TTS voice
schema.description: Empty uses the selected provider's default voice.
